intermediate.name: Piani di Pezzè
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Piani di Pezzè (151 km)

story: A restless first hour saw many attacks, but Lidl-Trek and Ineos kept the peloton together. Narvaez withdrew, losing his 2nd place in the points classification. A large breakaway including stage winner Sepp Kuss and top-10 contenders Gee-West, Storer & Caruso formed on Passo Duran. Ciccone successfully claimed the lead in the mountains classification and made a late solo attempt but was caught by Kuss.
